title: Distinct structural bases for sequence-specific DNA binding by mammalian BEN domain proteins.
authors: Zheng, Luqian; Liu, Jingjing; Niu, Lijie; Kamran, Mohammad; Yang, Ally W H; Jolma, Arttu; Dai, Qi; Hughes, Timothy R; Patel, Dinshaw J; Zhang, Long; Prasanth, Supriya G; Yu, Yang; Ren, Aiming; Lai, Eric C
one_liner_zh: 该文通过X射线晶体学与AlphaFold2/RoseTTAFold结构预测，解析哺乳动物BEN结构域蛋白（含BEND3）与DNA的序列特异性结合机制，属于蛋白质-DNA互作的结构与机制研究，但非典型TF-DNA体系，方法以实验结构为主、AI仅辅助预测，故评7分。
abstract: The BEN domain is a recently recognized DNA binding module that is present in diverse metazoans and certain viruses. Several BEN domain factors are known as transcriptional repressors, but, overall, relatively little is known of how BEN factors identify their targets in humans. In particular, X-ray structures of BEN domain:DNA complexes are only known for Drosophila factors bearing a single BEN domain, which lack direct vertebrate orthologs. Here, we characterize several mammalian BEN domain (BD) factors, including from two NACC family BTB-BEN proteins and from BEND3, which has four BDs. In vitro selection data revealed sequence-specific binding activities of isolated BEN domains from all of these factors. We conducted detailed functional, genomic, and structural studies of BEND3. We show that BD4 is a major determinant for in vivo association and repression of endogenous BEND3 targets. We obtained a high-resolution structure of BEND3-BD4 bound to its preferred binding site, which reveals how BEND3 identifies cognate DNA targets and shows differences with one of its non-DNA-binding BEN domains (BD1). Finally, comparison with our previous invertebrate BEN structures, along with additional structural predictions using AlphaFold2 and RoseTTAFold, reveal distinct strategies for target DNA recognition by different types of BEN domain proteins. Together, these studies expand the DNA recognition activities of BEN factors and provide structural insights into sequence-specific DNA binding by mammalian BEN proteins.
abstract_zh: BEN结构域是一种近期被识别的DNA结合模块，存在于多种后生动物及某些病毒中。已知若干BEN结构域因子作为转录抑制因子，但总体而言，关于BEN因子在人类中如何识别其靶标的了解相对较少。特别是，BEN结构域：DNA复合物的X射线结构仅见于携带单一BEN结构域的果蝇因子，而这些因子缺乏直接脊椎动物同源物。在此，我们表征了若干哺乳动物BEN结构域（BD）因子，包括来自两个NACC家族BTB-BEN蛋白及具有四个BD的BEND3。体外选择数据揭示了所有这些因子中分离的BEN结构域具有序列特异性结合活性。我们对BEND3进行了详细的功能、基因组及结构研究。我们表明BD4是体内关联及抑制内源性BEND3靶标的主要决定因素。我们获得了BEND3-BD4与其优选结合位点结合的高分辨率结构，这揭示了BEND3如何识别同源DNA靶标，并展示了与其非DNA结合BEN结构域（BD1）的差异。最后，与我们之前的无脊椎动物BEN结构比较，结合使用AlphaFold2和RoseTTAFold的额外结构预测，揭示了不同类型BEN结构域蛋白识别靶标DNA的不同策略。综合这些研究，扩展了BEN因子的DNA识别活性，并为哺乳动物BEN蛋白的序列特异性DNA结合提供了结构见解。
